title_sq: SHITET DYQAN BUZE RRUGES SE MYSLYM SHYRIT!
description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje dyqan buze rruges se Myslym Shyrit. 
Ambienti shtrihet ne nje siperfaqe prej 102 metrash katror dhe eshte i organizuar ne nje ambient te madh,
 dy tualete, depo dhe kend te vogel gatimi. 
Vendndodhja ne nje nga rruget kryesore tregtare te kryeqytetit e ben nje mundesi shume te mire
 per kedo qe kerkon te zhvilloje biznesin e tij. 
Fasada mundeson reklamimin e cdo lloj aktiviteti. 
Aktualisht ambienti eshte bosh dhe mund te sherbeje edhe si mundesi investimi per tu lene me qera.
Per nje vizite ne prone apo informacion jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni.
title_en: SHOP ON THE SIDE OF MYSLYM SHYRIT STREET FOR SALE!
description_en: Offered for sale is a shop on Myslym Shyr street. The environment covers an area of ​​102 square meters and is organized in a large environment, two toilets, storage and a small kitchen area. The location in one of the main commercial streets of the capital makes it a very good opportunity for anyone looking to develop their business. The facade enables the advertising of any type of activity. Currently, the environment is empty and can be used as an investment opportunity to rent. For a visit to the property or information, please contact us.
